purpose: Git-free pinned authority for this evaluation module. The owner ruling rejected Git-dependent authority reads for consolidated tests, so the governing clause and every digest/vocabulary contract this suite enforces are pinned here and read with ordinary filesystem reads.

provenance.why_pinned: The authority document is not present on disk in every worktree that must run this suite. Its digest anchors the pinned clause: when the document IS present under the resolved repository root, frozen-contracts.mjs verifies the document hash and relocates the clause inside it, so the pinned copy is upgraded to a real read wherever it can be.

raw64_digest_clause: 6. The effective configuration digest wire/storage form is raw lowercase 64 hexadecimal characters. The `sha256:` prefix is forbidden.
clause_quoting_note: raw64_digest_clause is a verbatim quotation of the authority document and MUST NOT be reworded. Its prose phrase 'effective configuration digest' names a concept, not a JSON field. The canonical JSON field name is configuration_digest; effective_configuration_digest is forbidden as a field name everywhere.

digest_form.description: Raw lowercase 64 hexadecimal characters. No prefix of any kind.

canonical_digest_fields.configuration_digest: Immutable configuration/version digest. An active version is represented by active_version_id (or active_version) plus that version record's configuration_digest.
canonical_digest_fields.capability_digest: Capability declaration/admission digest, covering values input, validation and activation result.

canonical_document_discriminator.note: Applies to runtime-manager JSON documents crossing the wire, including any issue.field label. This suite's own envelope key contract_version is the evaluation-module contract version and is a different thing; it is not a wire document discriminator.

canonical_spec.note: Read from disk under the resolved repository root and verified against this digest. A working-tree edit changes the hash and fails the gate, which is the same integrity guarantee the previous Git-object read provided.

boundary: Contains no credential value, account identity, provider-native secret, source-home filesystem path, or environment value. Evaluation metadata only.
